name: Smoked Salmon, Cottage Cheese & Egg Flatbread with Tossed Salad

instructions.primary_message: Divide flatbreads between two baking sheet pans. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, 5-6 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place cottage cheese in a strainer and press gently with the back of a spoon to remove excess liquid. Set aside to drain further.
When the flatbreads are done, spread the drained cottage cheese over top, creating a large well in the center of each. Crack an egg into each well.
Return baking sheets to the oven and bake until eggs are just set, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, chop or tear smoked salmon into bite-sized pieces. Place on a plate.
Peel and mince shallots. Add to the plate with the salmon, along with capers, and set aside for serving.
About 5 minutes before the flatbreads are done, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the dressing and radish, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: When the flatbreads are done, top with smoked salmon, minced shallot, and capers, then cut into wedges.
To serve, divide flatbreads and salad between plates. Enjoy!
